subject: Momentum digest — week of Jun 14 | QBR prep & priority asks
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: leadership@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Momentum digest — week of Jun 14 | QBR prep & priority asks

Team —

Quick consolidated update for exec distribution. Focused bullets so leadership can scan before the 1:00pm QBR sync. Pulling a short list of items where I need decisions or help this week.

Wins
- Completed dedicated capacity pricing pilot with two customers; telemetry shows 18% latency reduction at 95th pct with our new batching policy.
- Live demo template for multiregion failover is now in the playbook repo (linked below).
- Marketing secured a joint webinar with Acme (Mayors of FinTech) for July — good pipeline motion.

Risks / Observations
- SOC2 evidence collection: Acme procurement flagged missing retention logs for a subset of shared routes. They need artifacts for their security review by 6/21 to keep the procurement timetable.
- Several Dedicated customers are nearing burst capacity limits; autoscale tuning flagged potential 10% above committed throughput in peak windows if we don't adjust policies.
- One sales expansion at Acme is stalling on contract redlines (data residency language and indemnity).

Asks (short)
1) Laura — can you confirm approval to escalate the SOC2 evidence request to the infra incident runbook so we can pull logs sooner? If yes, I'll loop Security and send the required doc set to Acme. (Target: 6/18)
2) Jonas — please approve a short-term autoscale bump (2 weeks) for two Dedicated clusters (Oak-2 & Bay-1). Cost will be charged to the customer’s overage bucket; we need to avoid SLA slippage.
3) Marissa — can your renewal lead own the contract redline path with Acme? They asked for alternate residency wording; suggest we offer EU-only routing + audit clause.

Attachments: QBR_Priority_Roster.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_request.pdf (stubs)
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcQBR
HubSpot company: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/67890

Next steps: I will collect approvals in this thread and publish an action tracker by EOD today. If you prefer a 15-minute huddle, ping me and I’ll open a slot.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher | VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum digest — week of Jun 14 | QBR prep & priority asks

Thanks Sean — useful snapshot.

Quick Q on the SOC2 evidence: do we already have a pre-built extraction for the retention logs Acme requested, or will Security need to craft an ad hoc pull? If it's ad hoc, we should set expectations that 6/21 may be aggressive.

I'll review the roster and get back on approvals; happy to escalate the runbook pull if needed.

- Laura
Laura Bennett | COO (interim) | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:18:46 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum digest — week of Jun 14 | QBR prep & priority asks

Adding a quick note on the contract path — I'll take point.
- I'll prep a redline packet that offers EU-only routing + an audit clause and share it with Acme contracts by EOD tomorrow.
- On the autoscale ask: I support the temporary bump but we should attach a sunset clause and cost pass-through. Jonas, are you comfortable with 2 weeks?

Also flagging an operational risk: if we increase autoscale without a cache priming job, customers may see a cold-cache latency blip. Ops team can run priming; need ~30 minutes notice.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum digest — week of Jun 14 | QBR prep & priority asks

Perfect — thanks all. Quick status:
- Laura: please escalate to Security; if they confirm an existing extraction, we’ll meet Acme's 6/21 ask. If not, we'll propose a 6/25 delivery and inform procurement.
- Jonas: please confirm autoscale bump. If approved, I'll notify infra to schedule priming and open the billing exception.
- Marissa: appreciate owning the redline; copy me when you send the packet so I can loop the AE and legal.

I'll consolidate approvals and publish an action tracker in the Drive folder linked below. If anyone wants a 10-minute stand, I have 11:30–11:45 today.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcQBR
Doc: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QBRroster/view

Sean
